acceptance: The StarRocks smoke test passes on windows-latest in the nightly integration-smoke job
The load payload BenchBox sends is byte-identical on Windows and Linux, with a test
context: Found while reviewing open GitHub issues on 2026-11-12.
description:
## Problem
nightly-v2 run 43048718870 (2026-11-11), job "t3:integration-smoke | windows-latest py3.12", failed on tests/integration/platforms/test_starrocks_smoke_resource_heavy.py::test_starrocks_smoke_full_workflow with assert b'1,alpha\r\n2,beta\r\n' == b'1,alpha\n2,beta\n'. The Ubuntu leg passed. Tracked on GitHub as BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4109.

## Change
Find whether the CRLF comes from the code under test writing the load file in text mode on Windows (a product defect: StarRocks stream loads would then carry carriage returns) or from the test fixture. Fix the writer to emit LF bytes if it is the product, otherwise fix the fixture.
